post.title: Implement LLD for Parking Lot: Code Walkthrough
post.subtitle: Theory is good, code is better. We implement the Parking Lot system in Java, focusing on the Singleton, Factory, and Strategy patterns.
post.brief: This is the code companion to the [Parking Lot System Design](./lld-parking-lot-system) post. We implement the core classes (`ParkingLot`, `ParkingSpot`, `Ticket`) in Java, apply the **Singleton**, **Factory**, and **Strategy** patterns, and use a Min-Heap to find the nearest available spot in O(log n).
